summary: Fence requester-private jobs reads with the existing bound-identity administrative-read guard; fail closed for missing or unverifiable requester identity.

replay.detail: No replay changes. Deterministic receipt-race coverage forces two proven-absent snapshots and asserts exactly one stale-subject CAS recovery.

schema.detail: No schema changes. A router-level pending-subject fixture verifies HTTP 503 jobs-projection-stale.

rules.detail: All jobs paths, including future cancel/withdraw routes, are requester-private. Jobs GETs no longer inherit the bound-harness projection-read exemption. Existing bound-actor checks continue to fence writes; unverifiable ancestry refuses jobs methods, and local jobs authentication requires a concrete requester.

compatibility.detail: A bound harness cannot use x-st3-person to read or submit as another requester. Real-router fixtures cover list, show and submit with mismatched bound actor/header, plus unresolved ancestry.

downtime.detail: No downtime. Jobs remain disabled unless explicitly configured, and admission remains not wired.

recovery.detail: CAS losers resolve the same durable requester/key receipt; no rerun or alternate job ID is introduced.
